items: 【Comfortable and Portable Design】Over-ear earcups crafted from ultra-soft foam provide all-day comfort. The adjustable headband and flexible earcups easily fit any head shape without putting pressure on the ears. Crafted from durable plastic, they offer long-lasting resilience and durability. The lightweight, foldable design makes these wired headphones easy to carry in your bag, making them perfect for sports, commuting, or just listening at home.

【Long-lasting Battery Life】These headphones feature low-power technology and a built-in 400mAh battery. A one-hour charge provides approximately 35 hours of continuous playback and 180 hours of standby time, allowing you to comfortably wear them for commuting or leisure time without worrying about charging. The included audio cable allows these wireless headphones to easily switch to wired mode when powered off, eliminating the worry of running out of power.

【Bluetooth 5.4 Seamless Connection】Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 chip, these earbuds deliver faster, more stable transmission speeds and a range of up to 10 meters. They pair quickly with Bluetooth right after powering on. The 400mAh rechargeable battery charges quickly in just one hour. After 35 hours of playtime, you can switch the earbuds from wireless to wired mode for uninterrupted music enjoyment. No need to worry about running out of power on long trips.

【Immersive Music Experience】These active noise-canceling headphones feature an ANC microphone and high-fidelity 40mm drivers that detect and eliminate a wider range of low- and mid-frequency noises, such as car and airplane engines, for superior sound quality and a rich dynamic range. These over-ear headphones deliver high-fidelity sound quality and superior noise cancellation, allowing you to immerse yourself in your own music without external distractions.

【Widely Compatible and Usable】These over-ear headphones with microphone support a wide range of devices, including phones, computers, laptops, MP3 and MP4 players, and other audio-jack devices, making them suitable for sports, work, and leisure. The user-friendly built-in microphone allows for both phone calls and music playback. The included audio cable allows you to safely store your device in your bag or pocket while listening hands-free.
